hooks.command:
{ GCD="$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$GCD" ]; then ROOT="$(dirname "$GCD")"; else ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; fi; printf '=== ai.local (main repo root) ===
'; cat "${ROOT}/ai.local" 2>/dev/null || true; printf '
=== .github/ai/instructions.md ===
'; cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.github/ai/instructions.md" 2>/dev/null || true; } | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:.}}'
